name: French Lentils With Garlic and Thyme
assumptions: Yield estimated from 2.25 cups dry lentils (yields ~6-7 cups cooked) divided into 4 main-dish portions
Total time is sum of active sauté (5-10 min) + simmer (20-25 min) rounded to nearest 5; excludes optional stock variation
All ingredients plant-based; optional chicken stock in note ignored per instructions to use listed ingredients
No wheat, gluten, dairy, animal, or common allergen ingredients present
Bay leaves assumed removed before serving and contribute negligible weight/allergens
instructions:
Place a large saucepan over medium heat and add oil. When hot, add chopped vegetables and sauté until softened, 5 to 10 minutes.
Add 6 cups water, lentils, thyme, bay leaves and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a fast simmer.
Simmer lentils until they are tender and have absorbed most of the water, 20 to 25 minutes. If necessary, drain any excess water after lentils have cooked. Serve immediately, or allow them to cool and reheat later.
For a fuller taste, use some chicken stock and reduce the water by the same amount.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tbsp olive oil using standard 13.5 g per tbsp; pure oil values

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion, chopped, raw edible portion

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium carrot, chopped, raw edible portion

ingredients.name: French Lentils
ingredients.assumptions: 2 1/4 cups dry French (Puy) lentils using 184 g per cup; typical dry legume density and raw nutrient profile

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp dried thyme leaves; standard teaspoon weight and herb nutrition

ingredients.name: Bay Leaf
ingredients.assumptions: 3 bay leaves; negligible edible weight and contribution after cooking/removal

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp table salt; standard 18 g per tbsp, zero macros

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium celery sticks, chopped, raw edible portion
